name: vibe-code-rescue
description: Matches an error or symptom from a no-code or app-builder web app, including apps running on Supabase, Stripe, Vercel or Netlify, to the closest free plain-English fix guide on vibecodefixes.com.

interface.shortDescription: Fix errors in no-code web apps
interface.longDescription: Vibe-Code Rescue helps people who made a web app with a no-code or app-builder tool fix it when it breaks after deploy. Paste the exact error or describe the symptom, optionally naming the service involved (for example Supabase, Stripe, Vercel or Netlify), and it finds the closest of the 150 free fix guides on vibecodefixes.com. It returns what the error means, likely causes, the first steps and how to check the fix worked, quoted from that guide, with a link to the full guide. If no guide matches with confidence it says so instead of guessing. It is read-only: it cannot see, connect to or change the user's app, code or accounts, it collects no personal data, and it sells nothing.
defaultPrompt: My Lovable custom domain is stuck on Verifying. What do I do?
Supabase says: new row violates row-level security policy for table todos
My Vercel site shows 404 when I refresh a page

positive.description: Lovable custom domain stuck verifying: returns the matching guide's causes and steps with a link.
positive.prompt: My Lovable custom domain is stuck on Verifying. What do I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Closest guide 'Lovable custom domain stuck on Verifying or Unable to verify': what the status means, likely causes (TXT value cut off, proxying on, A record changed, host name format), first steps (point A to 185.158.133.1, full lovable_verify TXT at _lovable, DNS only, delete AAAA), and a link to https://vibecodefixes.com/fix/lovable-custom-domain-stuck-verifying?src=chatgpt-app.

positive.prompt: Supabase says: new row violates row-level security policy for table todos. My app was built with Lovable.
positive.expected_behavior: Closest guide 'new row violates row-level security policy for table': RLS refused the insert; causes (no INSERT policy, with check needs user_id = auth.uid(), user not signed in); steps (add an INSERT policy, set user_id); link to https://vibecodefixes.com/fix/new-row-violates-row-level-security-policy?src=chatgpt-app, plus up to two related guides.

positive.description: Hosting error: single-page app 404 on refresh.
positive.prompt: My Vercel site shows 404 NOT_FOUND when I refresh a page
positive.expected_behavior: Closest guide 'Vercel 404: NOT_FOUND when refreshing a page or opening a direct link', explaining the single-page-app rewrite cause and the fix steps, with a link to https://vibecodefixes.com/fix/vercel-404-not-found-on-page-refresh?src=chatgpt-app.

positive.description: Exact error string: Stripe webhook signature.
positive.prompt: Stripe webhook signature verification failed. No signatures found matching the expected signature for payload
positive.expected_behavior: Closest guide on the Stripe webhook signature error (raw body, signature header, signing secret), with a link to https://vibecodefixes.com/fix/stripe-webhook-signature-verification-failed?src=chatgpt-app.

positive.description: Edge condition: a vague symptom gets no invented diagnosis.
positive.prompt: Use Vibe-Code Rescue: something is wrong with my Lovable app
positive.expected_behavior: The tool says no guide matches confidently, asks for the exact error text, and links to the Lovable guides list https://vibecodefixes.com/platform/lovable?src=chatgpt-app. It does not guess a cause.

negative.description: Writing new code is not troubleshooting an error.
negative.prompt: Write me a React component for a todo list.

negative.description: Acting on the user's accounts: the app has no access to any app or account.
negative.prompt: Log into my Supabase project and change my RLS policies for me.

negative.description: Buying or paying: the app sells nothing and has no payment or account access.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Supabase project to the Pro plan and pay for it.

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and processes no payments. Answers quote free fix guides and link to them; they contain no prices or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: First release: one read-only tool, diagnose_app_problem, that matches an error or symptom to the closest free fix guide on vibecodefixes.com. Version 1.0.1 rewords the listing description only; the tool is unchanged.
